mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for glass partition installation in Alameda County?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether a permit is required for glass partition installation in Alameda County depends on the scope of the project and local building codes. Minor cosmetic changes typically don't require a permit, but structural modifications, changes to fire-rated assemblies, or significant alterations to existing floor plans often do.
